_meta.description: Seed race data for Runners' Races MX (Running App MVP). Real 2026-2027 races in Monterrey / Nuevo León, compiled via research agents and deduped across three sources (AANL calendar, Idemsport, Asdeporte, Hub Sports, TriTour, official race sites). Second sweep 2026-07-04: added Idemsport/AANL calendar races missed in the first pass (excluded one employees-only private event). CDMX/EdoMex sweep 2026-07-05: 3-angle fan-out per the Race Research Playbook (flagship, aggregators, trail), deduped. Third sweep 2026-07-13: added 7 more metros (Mérida/Yucatán, Tijuana+Ensenada/Baja California, León+Guanajuato-state, Cancún+Quintana Roo, San Luis Potosí, Saltillo+Coahuila-state, Chihuahua+Juárez) via race-research skill, 81 races.
_meta.warning: Dates/times for medium/low-confidence entries were not fully confirmed for the 2026-2027 edition. Verify against signupUrl before trusting. Fields left null were not confirmable (never guessed).
_meta.linkSweep: 2026-07-04: registration links verified via runera.mx (reliable for Trotime SPA GUIDs) and asdeporte.com. Organizer patterns: Asdeporte publishes ~5-6 months ahead; Trotime a few months. Unverified GUIDs stay in notes, not signupUrl.
